taken.en: {missing} is gone. That much the village will say, and no more.
taken.fr: {missing} n'est plus la. Cela, le village veut bien le dire, et rien de plus.

outcomes.en: {missing} lies in the ground, or under the water, and the village has agreed to call that rest.
outcomes.fr: {missing} repose sous la terre, ou sous l'eau, et le village a convenu d'appeler cela le repos.

outcomes.en: {missing} got out. Somewhere past the last road a door opens for {missing}, and no one here will ever be told which.
outcomes.fr: {missing} s'est echappe. Quelque part au-dela de la derniere route une porte s'ouvre pour {missing}, et personne ici ne saura laquelle.

outcomes.en: {missing} answered, and now sings with the others where the tide should not reach.
outcomes.fr: {missing} a repondu, et chante maintenant avec les autres la ou la maree ne devrait pas monter.

outcomes.en: Something wears the shape of {missing} and walks the village at the hour of the second bell. It is patient. It is learning the way home.
outcomes.fr: Quelque chose porte la forme de {missing} et parcourt le village a l'heure de la seconde cloche. Cela est patient. Cela apprend le chemin du retour.

outcomes.en: {missing} is still in {village}, behind a wall or beneath a floor, and has stopped answering when called.
outcomes.fr: {missing} est toujours a {village}, derriere un mur ou sous un plancher, et ne repond plus quand on l'appelle.

outcomes.en: {missing} stepped out of the order of the nights. The hour that holds {missing} is not one this village will reach.
outcomes.fr: {missing} est sorti de l'ordre des nuits. L'heure qui retient {missing} n'est pas de celles que ce village atteindra.

planted.en: Someone swears {missing} was seen at the water door, calm and well, and asked that nobody look further. The voice was steady. It was too steady.
planted.fr: Quelqu'un jure avoir vu {missing} a la porte de l'eau, calme et en paix, demandant que personne ne cherche plus loin. La voix etait assuree. Trop assuree.

displaced.en: A shape stood a moment at the edge of the lamplight, wearing the face of {missing}. It was gone before the eye could keep it, and it left a place where the day had run twice.
displaced.fr: Une forme s'est tenue un instant au bord de la lumiere des lampes, portant le visage de {missing}. Elle a disparu avant que l'oeil la retienne, et elle a laisse un endroit ou le jour s'est joue deux fois.

reason.en: Someone gone from the village is placed where they cannot have been. One of these two accounts has been bent by the thing that took them.
reason.fr: Quelqu'un qui a quitte le village est place la ou il ne peut pas avoir ete. L'un de ces deux recits a ete plie par ce qui l'a emporte.

constraints.basis: story m1 chat 2 says she did not fall and was asked; lore p01 says it is not yet over
story m2 chat 2 says he is aboard the wreck and counted twice; the letters still arrive
story m3 chat 2 says the abbey took her in; lore p03 has the ink wet
story m4 chat 2 says the lights are keeping her; lore p04 says the footprints do not return
story m5 chat 2 says the extra grave was for him and he knew; lore p05 has the grave deeper than yesterday
